# ד״ר סיון שני – מרפאה וטרינרית

This website belongs to Dr. Sivan Shani, a professional veterinary clinic in Israel providing comprehensive medical care for pets. 

## Core Services
- Routine vaccinations and health treatments.
- General medical examinations for new and returning pets.
- Surgical procedures including spaying, neutering, and specialized operations.
- Professional dental cleaning under anesthesia.
- Comprehensive medical consultations and pet health management.

## User Capabilities
- Book appointments online via the scheduling system.
- Manage and cancel appointments using secure tokens.
- View clinic services, team information, and FAQs.
- Access contact information and directions to the clinic.

## Technical Context
The site is a React-based web application with an integrated appointment management system, dashboard for clinic staff, and automated email/SMS notification capabilities for pet owners.
